name: Advance-fee prize scam
description: The target is promised an unexpected prize but must first pay a processing, tax, delivery, or release fee.

name: OTP or account-takeover scam
description: An impersonator asks for an OTP, PIN, password, CVV, recovery code, or other secret to take control of an account.

name: Fake job and recruitment-fee scam
description: A high-paying or easy job is offered with little screening, followed by a demand for training, registration, equipment, or security fees.

name: Parcel and delivery phishing
description: A delivery problem or small fee is used to send the target to a fake tracking or payment page.

name: Bank or wallet impersonation
description: The sender pretends to be a bank or wallet provider and creates urgency around a blocked account, unauthorized payment, or identity check.

name: Guaranteed investment return scam
description: The target is promised unusually high or guaranteed returns and is pushed toward a difficult-to-reverse transfer.

name: Remote-access technical support scam
description: A fake support representative claims there is a device or account problem and asks the target to install remote-access software.

name: Marketplace buyer or payment scam
description: A fake buyer or seller moves the conversation off-platform and sends a false payment, courier, or refund link.

name: Government or authority impersonation
description: The scammer claims to represent police, tax, immigration, utilities, or another authority and demands immediate action or payment.

name: Account verification phishing
description: A message claims an account must be verified or updated through a supplied link, which may capture login details.
